regenerationJustification.rationale: #22934's cancellation charter names the interrupt-versus-queued-successor arm. This fixture is the committed cancel-mid-turn exchange with the stop sent on the priority lane and a second submit queued behind the running turn before the stop: the queued turn/start acked queued with its pre-minted turnId, turn/interrupt on the running turn accepted, the in-flight tool call completed cancelled and the turn's cancelled terminal as cancel-mid-turn records them, apart from the command below, then the SS4.13 queue-movement replay of the queued commandId answered with its original ack, the queued turn's turn/started under its own commandId, its userMessage, the agent's answer and its completed terminal. No frame before the queued submit differs from cancel-mid-turn beyond the fresh identifiers and the tool call's command (lines 11 and 12 run `npm run test:integration` under a vitest banner where cancel-mid-turn runs a Cargo command); the cancelled result on line 17 carries the same command; the interrupt carries no retract member, as the SDK sends it.
